Regular use alongside a nutritious diet and active lifestyle may help encourage healthy ovulation, balanced estrogen, and improved libido, preparing the body for fertility planning. The vegetarian powder mixes easily and is designed for daily use as part of a holistic routine; results vary by individual and consistency. External medical conditions require professional guidance; this product does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent disease.
